text:
The review is written, and the verdict is **fix**: three of the five asks in the brief are not fully met. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/flat-route/review/report.md`.

## What needs fixing
- **One flat link is left:** `public/framework/ai/AISession/SessionTasksGrid.js:49` still links the Tasks grid's "Session" cell with `AICost.session_url`, which builds `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/`. It should use `AICost.session_href`, like the four links the branch already fixed.
- **One commit has unrelated files:** commit `9ea688364` on branch `worktree/qf-2` picked up 100+ files this task didn't touch: regenerated `files.jsonl` files, `board.jsonl` lines, and lines in `public/live/page.jsonl` and `public/live/design/page.jsonl`. Those /live/ lines are also the only reason the /live/ pages were screenshotted. They should come off the branch before it merges.
- **Some docs still give the flat path:** `core/Page/doc/architecture.md:61` (a file this same diff edited), `Servex/agents/Agents.js:227`, `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:74,78`, `ai/sessions/doc/asks/asks.md:15` and `ux/Dictate/doc/asks.md:92`.
- **The new link helper isn't documented:** `AICost.session_href` is in no readme, so nothing tells a fresh agent that `session_url` is now only the cost lookup key, never a link.
- **The task log isn't enough to continue from:** the brief asked for a list of every place, but the log has one summary line ("~20 live docs"). It names 2 commits while the branch has 3, and Servex closed the task, not the agent that did the work.

## What's fine
- **Decision:** keeping the redirect for bare-uuid links is written down with the alternative, because existing pages still link to it.
- **The two docs:** `indexing-past-work.md` and the sessions readme both now say the dated folder is the only address.
- **Tests:** the log says all four pass. I did not run them again.

## Screenshots
Each page was shot at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440. On screen this diff changes only one line of text on the Dictate surfaces page. Nothing new overflows or wraps, and none of the design checks failed.

Two minor notes are in the report: a stale "(flat URL)" heading in `ai/sessions/doc/views-plan.md`, and Servex needs a restart before the new tool and agent text takes effect.

The second review is written, and the verdict is **fix**: five links in live code still build the old `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/` address. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/flat-route/review/report.md`.

## Still to fix
- **Five live links still use the old address.** They are in `ext/Refine/PromptView.js:96` and `:101`, `ai/rail/DashRow.js:53` (a dashboard row), `core/Page/PageInbox.js:111` and `core/Role/RoleView.js:69`. Each builds the address by joining strings, so the search pattern in the brief never matched them. The brief says code that builds the old address must build the dated one instead. The minion listed PromptView as "left on purpose" and used it as the reason to keep the redirect. Once these links are switched to `AICost.session_href(id)`, check again whether the redirect can go.
- **The task log's list of places is incomplete.** It misses those five files, so a fresh agent would trust a list with gaps. Add them to the log, or give the search that finds addresses built by joining strings.

## Fixed since the first review
- All of the first review's findings are fixed:
  - The last Tasks-grid link now uses the dated folder.
  - The unrelated files that were swept into a commit are gone. The branch is 4 commits and 35 files, the same as the diff.
  - The leftover doc lines are rewritten.
  - `session_href` is documented in the AITask and AISession readmes.
  - The log has a full fixed and left-alone list, and the minion closed the task itself.
- I reran the four tests on `worktree/qf-2` at `ea224220f`, and all pass: page_tools 44, handoff-route 8, session-route-tasks 13, SessionConsolidate ok.
- **Requirements 3 and 4 are met.** The docs, tool descriptions and hook text name the dated folder as the only address.

## Notes
- **Servex needs a restart after the merge** before the new `page_tools.js` and `Agents.js` text takes effect. A restart was already asked of voice-app.
- **The design checks pass for this change.** The shots of `/framework/ux/Dictate/surfaces/` came at all four widths, and the only change there is one line of text, lower on the page than any shot reaches. At 3440 the page is 69% empty, but that layout was already there before this change.
- **The `/live/` shot folders are left over from the first round** and are not evidence for this change.

This third review's verdict is **fix**: the browser links are fixed, but server-side code still builds the old flat session address. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/flat-route/review/report.md`.

## What needs fixing
- **Four places still build the flat address `/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/`:**
  - `Server/AskIndex.mjs:47` (the link it writes into module inboxes)
  - `Servex/ext/refine/TagRouter.js:63` (the tag note's text)
  - `Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:39` (a card's source)
  - `Server/RefineQueue.mjs:171` (the prompt page fallback)

  All four run in node, where the dated folder is easy to look up. The first three also write the address into committed notes and cards, so each run adds another old link that still needs the redirect.
- **The task log's list of places is incomplete.** It only covers `public/` and the docs, and doesn't say whether the server-side builders were missed or left on purpose. A fresh agent working from the task folder alone would trust a list that leaves them out. The report gives a search that finds them.

## Notes
- `Servex/agents/doc/own-page.md:14` still has the old "only redirects there" wording. The same diff rewrote line 6 of that file, so the two lines no longer match.
- Servex needs a restart before the new `page_tools.js` and `Agents.js` text takes effect.
- The one page change is a single table cell on the Dictate surfaces page, below the fold in every shot. The shots show the page still draws and the layout hasn't changed. They don't show the edited cell.

## What is met
- The browser links now go to the dated folder (`AISession.page_url`, `AICost.session_href`).
- The tool descriptions, the start-up hook message, agents.md, `indexing-past-work.md` and the sessions readme all name the dated folder as the only address.
- The decision line keeps the redirect for old committed links and says what the alternative was.
- All four tests pass; I reran them on branch `worktree/qf-2`.

I was given 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440 px shots of `/framework/ux/Dictate/surfaces/`. The `/live/` shot folders are left over from round 1 and aren't evidence for this branch.
